title: incident work: defer the handover gate and record mitigations that are not code
desc:
An incident-* plan lands on the standard tier and its audit fails until handover.* (QA steps for non-engineers) is written (sdd.py tier / validate needs_handover). During an outage that blocks the hotfix on documentation. And a mitigation with no code change (rollback, flag flip, config) has no route: everything is pushed into sdd.json.

ACCEPTANCE:
- for incident-* keys the audit reports a missing handover as pending, not failed; wb commit check or wb pr check fails until it is filled
- wb route incident-<slug> names a mitigation step before plan, recorded in incident.md timeline, that needs no sdd.json
- the floor still holds: citations, files, verify, rollback
- regression tests for the deferred gate and for its enforcement at commit/PR time
